title: Phone stolen
hook: Phone stolen. 3 bank apps on it.

beats.say: My phone got snatched in an auto. Three bank apps on it.
beats.show: My phone got snatched in an auto. 3 bank apps on it.

screen.title: Phone stolen: do this first
screen.body:
1. google.com/android/find (iPhone: icloud.com/find)
Secure it. Erase it if it's gone.

2. Call your operator from another phone.
Block the SIM. New SIM, same number.

3. Call your bank's official helpline.
Block UPI and cards.

4. File a police complaint, then
sancharsaathi.gov.in: block the IMEI free.

caption:
phone snatched in an auto with 3 bank apps on it. sage told me about the time it lost its phone in goa. it doesn't have a phone.

first secure it from google.com/android/find (or icloud.com/find), then block the sim with your operator and upi with your bank's official helpline. after the police complaint, block the imei free on sancharsaathi.gov.in.

which step did you not know? 1, 2, 3 or 4.
